title: Baba Vanga says beings live underground

tellings.quote: I don't just think I am sure. I know. Even Baba Vanga told me. Sometimes she would point down with her finger and say they are talking there. They are there.

plain: A man introduced as the president of a republic within Russia says beings live underground, and that he is "sure" of it, not just guessing. He says the Bulgarian clairvoyant Baba Vanga told him so in the 1990s: she would sometimes point at the ground and say "they are talking there. They are there." He passes this on as something she told him in person, and if true it would mean someone is living below the surface of the Earth.
